#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
P=/workspace/skills/tools/decision-records/experiments/rust-native-cli/delivery
B=/tmp/decision-records-rust-target/release/decision-records-rust-experiment
D=$PWD
VERSION=0.1.0
EXPECTED=863e91862111f68e7a54505d14369a8d2afcdb2f37aac371f0a0f5099676e788
test "$(sha256sum "$B" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$EXPECTED"
test "$(realpath .)" = "$(realpath "$D")"
test -f "$D/package.json"
mkdir "$D/tars"
python3 "$P/build.py" --binary "$B" --version "$VERSION" --output "$D/build"
test "$(sha256sum "$D/build/artifact/decision-records" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$EXPECTED"
npm pack --prefix "$D" --cache "$D/cache" --offline --ignore-scripts --pack-destination "$D/tars" "$D/build/platform" "$D/build/wrapper"
TIMEFORMAT=$'real %R\nuser %U\nsys %S'
{ time npm install --prefix "$D" --cache "$D/cache" --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund "$D"/tars/*.tgz; } 2> "$D/npm-install.time"
{ time python3 "$P/install.py" --source "$D/build/artifact" --version "$VERSION" --sha256 "$EXPECTED" --output "$D/installed"; } 2> "$D/local-install.time"
sha256sum "$D/build/artifact/decision-records" "$D/node_modules/dr-experiment-linux-x64/decision-records" "$D/installed" > "$D/hashes.txt"
for test in list trace invalid; do
  case $test in
    list) args=(list --limit 1 --root /workspace/skills);;
    trace) args=(trace 261105-route-test-design-and-existing-review --json --root /workspace/skills);;
    invalid) args=(definitely-invalid);;
  esac
  for variant in direct npm local; do
    case $variant in
      direct) executable="$D/build/artifact/decision-records";;
      npm) executable="$D/node_modules/.bin/dr-experiment";;
      local) executable="$D/installed";;
    esac
    set +e
    "$executable" "${args[@]}" > "$D/$test-$variant.stdout" 2> "$D/$test-$variant.stderr"
    code=$?
    set -e
    printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$D/$test-$variant.exit"
  done
  for variant in npm local; do
    cmp "$D/$test-direct.stdout" "$D/$test-$variant.stdout"
    cmp "$D/$test-direct.stderr" "$D/$test-$variant.stderr"
    cmp "$D/$test-direct.exit" "$D/$test-$variant.exit"
  done
  if test "$test" = invalid; then test "$(cat "$D/$test-direct.exit")" -ne 0; else test "$(cat "$D/$test-direct.exit")" -eq 0; fi
done
